description: This file implements the DatabaseConnection class, which manages database connectivity, execution of queries, and retrieval of results within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes methods for connecting, disconnecting, executing queries, and handling callbacks for query results.

classes.name: DatabaseConnection
classes.description: Manages database connection lifecycle, query execution, and result processing within the plugin.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the specified database, opening or creating it as needed.

methods.name: DisConnect
methods.description: Closes the current database connection if open.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a SQL query on the connected database.

methods.name: ExecAndGetModified
methods.description: Executes a query and retrieves the number of affected rows.

methods.name: ExecAndGetResults
methods.description: Executes a query and retrieves the result set into a DatabaseTable object.

methods.name: DbCallbackOnly
methods.description: Callback invoked for queries that do not return results, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: DbCallbackGetResults
methods.description: Callback invoked to process query results and populate a DatabaseTable.
